tbesh_html:
1) to cut, sharpen, decide, decree, determine, maim, move, be decisive, be mutilated
1a)(Qal)
1a1) to cut, mutilate
1a2) to sharpen
1a3) to decide
1b) (Niphal) to be decisive

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to point sharply, i.e. (literally) to wound; figuratively, to be alert, to decide
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bestir self, decide, decree, determine, maim, move.
